previous_statement: By def-positive-approximate-retract, the displayed positive unital maps A:l-infinity(k)->l-infinity(n) and M:l-infinity(n)->l-infinity(k) have probability-vector rows and are exactly the structural kind of maps required by lem-prh.
new_statement: Dimension-domain bridge for PRH: either k,n >= 1, in which case the positive unital maps A and M have probability-vector rows and satisfy the structural and dimension hypotheses of lem-prh, or k=n=0, in which case the unique endomorphism E of l-infinity(0) is a stochastic idempotent with ||AM-E||_{infinity->infinity}=0 and directly satisfies the conclusion required in node 1.2; the mixed cases k=0<n and n=0<k are incompatible with the existence of both displayed positive unital maps.
